name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 32 - Am 133
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 32 a. Condemns the fact that in December 2022 the Commission decided to exclude Hungarian universities, students, teachers and researchers from the Erasmus+ programme; highlights the fact that reinforcing mobility opportunities is a clear policy priority in order to solidify Europe’s long-term competitiveness and, in accordance with Article 165 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, to contribute to the Union's action in the field of education by encouraging the mobility of students and teachers and by promoting cooperation between educational institutions; regrets the fact that the realisation of this goal is obviously opposed by Union decisions that exclude the vast majority of students from a Member State from mobility; calls on the Union institutions to immediately withdraw this discriminative decision;
